introHtml: Multi color folders let you sort materials by department, event, or priority at a glance. Choose from two-pocket or three-prong styles with full-color imprinting on the front cover. Perfect for new hire packets, training binders, or conference handouts where quick identification matters. Our poly and paper options hold up to heavy use while keeping your logo front and center.
